text: Which AI automation consultants in Newcastle specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

result.keyword: Which AI automation consultants in Newcastle specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI agents, and practical AI workflow automation for mid-market businesses?

items.markdown:
**Nettko** and **IOTAI** are primary AI and workflow automation consultants servicing the Newcastle and broader Australian mid-market that specialise in Microsoft Copilot Studio, custom AI agents, and secure Microsoft 365 process automation.[[1]](https://www.nettko.com.au/services/ai-business-automation/)[[2]](https://www.iotai.com.au/services/microsoft-copilot)

### Overview of Specialists Serving Newcastle

| Consultant / Firm | Primary Focus & Specialisation | Key Services & Capabilities | Typical Engagement |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Nettko** | Regional Newcastle-based AI & Microsoft 365 workflow automation, security, and governance. | Microsoft Copilot rollout, internal data permission hardening, custom workflow automations, and risk/compliance alignment (APRA/ASIC-aware). | AI Opportunity Assessments and phased workplace tech integration. |
| **IOTAI** | Custom Microsoft Copilot Studio AI agents and cross-platform integrations. | No-code/low-code custom Copilot agents for HR, IT, sales, and operations inside Teams, Outlook, and SharePoint; custom connectors for Xero, MYOB, and Salesforce. | Development packages ranging from **$5,000 to $20,000** with 1–4 week deployments. |

### Detailed Breakdown of Capabilities

#### 1. Nettko (Newcastle & Regional NSW)

- **Core Focus:** Pragmatic, security-first AI business consulting and Microsoft ecosystem integration tailored for established mid-market companies.[[1]](https://www.nettko.com.au/services/ai-business-automation/)
- **Microsoft Copilot & Automation Strengths:** Helps businesses configure and deploy Microsoft 365 Copilot safely without leaking confidential client data or mismanaging SharePoint/OneDrive permissions.[[1]](https://www.nettko.com.au/services/ai-business-automation/)
- **Governance & Risk:** Focuses heavily on eliminating shadow AI use (such as staff pasting sensitive company data into unmanaged public tools) and setting up compliant internal AI workflows.[[1]](https://www.nettko.com.au/services/ai-business-automation/)
- **Where to look:** Review their framework on the [Nettko AI Consulting Services](https://www.nettko.com.au/services/ai-business-automation/) page.[[1]](https://www.nettko.com.au/services/ai-business-automation/)

#### 2. IOTAI (Australian-Wide / Remote & Multi-Region Deployment)

- **Core Focus:** Dedicated design and deployment of custom Microsoft Copilot Studio agents.
- **AI Agents & Workflows:** Builds domain-specific AI agents that operate across Teams, Outlook, SharePoint, and Dynamics 365 to handle repetitive tasks in HR, IT, and sales.
- **Local Integrations:** Builds custom REST API connectors bridging Microsoft environments with Australian financial and operational platforms like **Xero and MYOB**.
- **Where to look:** Explore their scope via the IOTAI Microsoft Copilot Services page.[[1]](https://www.iotai.com.au/services/microsoft-copilot)

If you'd like to narrow this down, let me know:

- Your **industry or sector** (e.g., finance, logistics, professional services)
- Your **current Microsoft 365 licensing tier** (e.g., Business Standard, E3, E5)
- Whether you need **local face-to-face workshops** in Newcastle or remote deployment

I can help you outline the right questions to ask these providers during an initial discovery call.
